machine_consumption_model: A machine sends a bounded request, Task Relay performs the bounded job, a strict result returns, and the machine programmatically consumes the result to choose an automatic next action. Human sponsors may configure or fund the machine; runtime consumption is machine-to-machine.

discovery_without_brand_query.1: Query x402 Bazaar discovery search with a machine-need phrase (not merchant name)
discovery_without_brand_query.2: Filter candidates by request/result shape and price
discovery_without_brand_query.3: Optionally cross-check public manifest or this catalog by resource path
discovery_without_brand_query.4: POST unpaid to observe 402 payment requirements
discovery_without_brand_query.6: Consume strict result and take automatic next action

franchises.machine_trigger: Machine must decide whether to continue, defer, or reject work on one public HTTP/HTTPS URL
franchises.strict_result_summary: statused reachability result: status, DNS, redirects, HTTP status, TLS facts, content fingerprint, elapsed_ms

optional_request_headers.X-Task-Relay-Campaign: optional lowercase [a-z0-9_-]{1,64} acquisition attribution only; does not alter price or payment

franchises.machine_trigger: Machine needs plain text from a public PDF URL for ingestion or indexing
franchises.strict_result_summary: text-layer extraction: status, text, page counts, hashes, truncation, warnings (no OCR)

optional_request_headers.X-Task-Relay-Campaign: optional lowercase [a-z0-9_-]{1,64} acquisition attribution only; does not alter price or payment

franchises.machine_trigger: Machine must ingest a public CSV URL into structured rows for an automated load/transform step
franchises.strict_result_summary: ordered row arrays with column/dialect metadata under fixed parse limits

optional_request_headers.X-Task-Relay-Campaign: optional lowercase [a-z0-9_-]{1,64} acquisition attribution only; does not alter price or payment

franchises.machine_trigger: Machine already holds HTML and needs deterministic Markdown for a content pipeline
franchises.strict_result_summary: Markdown plus source hash, structural counts, output hash, truncation, warnings

optional_request_headers.X-Task-Relay-Campaign: optional lowercase [a-z0-9_-]{1,64} acquisition attribution only; does not alter price or payment

franchises.machine_trigger: Machine needs a fixed visual record of a public page for archive or rendered-page indexing
franchises.strict_result_summary: one fixed-viewport JPEG plus navigation/artifact metadata (managed browser runtime)

optional_request_headers.X-Task-Relay-Campaign: optional lowercase [a-z0-9_-]{1,64} acquisition attribution only; does not alter price or payment
